cards.text: Jesus is at the Passover table with His apostles, and He's just said the hand of His betrayer is right there on the table with His (Luke 22:14, 21). Then they begin to question among themselves which of them is going to do this (Luke 22:23). And then a dispute breaks out among the disciples.

cards.question: At the Passover table, a dispute breaks out among the disciples. What is it about?

answers.text: Which of them should be considered the greatest
Which of them should lead the Passover prayer
Which of them should go out to buy supplies

cards.text: I'm the only one on my whole planet, and friend, I STILL lose arguments with my oven about who's in charge. Then Jesus steps in: the kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority call themselves benefactors.

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples they shall not be like the kings of the Gentiles.

cards.text: Instead, Jesus flips the whole ladder upside down. The greatest among them should be like the youngest.

cards.question: Jesus says the one who leads should be like the one who ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks who's greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves. And He answers it Himself: “Is it not the one who reclines?”

cards.question: Jesus says He is among the disciples as one who reclines at the table.

cards.text: Then Jesus turns to them. They're the ones, He says, who have stood by Him in His trials.

cards.question: Jesus bestows a kingdom on the disciples. Who does He say has bestowed a kingdom on Him?
In His kingdom, Jesus says, the disciples will eat and drink at His ___.

cards.text: Stand by Him in His trials, and you get a seat at His table AND a throne? Friend, the dead batteries I shared that junk drawer with stood by me for YEARS, and the best I could give them was a spot under a takeout menu.

cards.question: Jesus says the disciples will sit on thrones in His kingdom. What will they be doing there?

answers.text: Judging the twelve tribes of Israel
Teaching the nations of the earth
Counting the people of every land

cards.text: Then Jesus turns to Simon, whom He named Peter (Luke 6:14), with a warning about Satan, the devil. “Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat.”

cards.question: Satan has asked to sift the disciples like wheat. What has Jesus done for Simon?

answers.text: Prayed that his faith will not fail
Sent an angel to stand guard over him
Told him to hide until morning comes

cards.text: And Jesus gives Simon a job. When he has turned back, he's to strengthen his brothers.

cards.question: Peter answers Jesus. How far does he say he's ready to go with Him?

answers.text: Even to prison and to death
Even through the storm and the sea
Even into the desert and the wild

cards.text: PRISON. And DEATH. I stared at a jar of sprinkles for a whole WEEK before I committed to it. But Jesus answers Peter with a word about a rooster.

cards.question: Peter says he's ready to go with Jesus even to prison and to death. What does Jesus say Peter will do before the rooster crows today?

answers.text: Deny three times that he knows Jesus
Leave Jerusalem before the sun comes up
Go back home to Galilee tonight

cards.text: Then Jesus asks them all a question. Back when He sent them out without purse or bag or sandals, did they lack anything?

cards.question: Jesus asks if the disciples lacked anything when He sent them out without purse or bag or sandals. They answer: ___.

cards.text: But now, Jesus tells them, things are different.

cards.question: Now Jesus tells the one with a purse to leave it behind.
Jesus says the one without a sword should sell his cloak and ___ one.

cards.text: Then Jesus points to a Scripture about Himself, from the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 53:12): “And He was numbered with the transgressors.”

cards.question: Jesus says what is written about Him is reaching its fulfillment.
When the disciples show Jesus two swords, He tells them to go and get more.

cards.text: “That is enough,” He answers. And that's where the table talk ends for now, but friend, this night is just getting started.
